issue.title: Visual flake: agents_fleet_remote_tribe_families golden captures live neighbor and active-agent state under host load
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-12z.5.2 as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and independently reproduced and characterized by the sase-12z.5 land agent on 2026-09-20.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observed 2026-09-20 on athena in workspace sase_29 at master 624a29ea7 by the sase-12z.5
land agent, with `just test-visual` (check-only, never writes goldens).

Fail/pass pattern on one unchanged tree (6 runs, no source edits between them):

- FAIL, full suite run: `counts: created=0 updated=1 unchanged=690 stale=0`, the single
  drift being this golden.
- FAIL, targeted single-file run: `created=0 updated=1 unchanged=6 stale=0`.
- FAIL, targeted single-file run with the sase-12z.5 source changes reverted
  (`git checkout 9a56fc129~1 --` on `_display_panel_widgets.py`, `_agent_detail_panels.py`
  and `agent_list.py`): same drift, so the epic's panel-repaint work is not the cause.
- PASS, 7-file targeted run: `created=0 updated=18 unchanged=20` with this golden among
  the unchanged.
- PASS, targeted single-file run: `unchanged=7`.
- PASS, targeted single-file run: `unchanged=7`.
- PASS, full suite run: `972 passed, 1 skipped`, `created=0 updated=0 unchanged=709
  stale=0`.

The three failures were consecutive and happened while the host was also running a full
visual suite; the three passes were consecutive on a quieter host, which matches the
load-sensitivity phase sase-12z.5.2 recorded for this exact golden ("agents_fleet_remote
_tribe_families_120x40 once captured neighbors/expanded-family state in a first capture").
Serial (non-xdist) reproduction was not attempted.

Captured difference (failing candidate vs committed golden):

- header gains a `[neighbors: 4 (~)]` chip the golden does not have;
- `here: athena - 1 active - 1 machine` becomes `3 active`;
- the footer `X cleanup (1 done)` becomes `(5 done)`;
- the families collapse into `x3` / `x2` multiplier rows in the golden but render fully
  expanded with their child shells in the failing capture.

The test builds a fixed `OfflineFleetFacade` from `_fleet_tribe_family_response()`, pins
now with `pin_agents_visual_now`, and calls `patch_startup_loaders(monkeypatch, agents=[])`,
so a local active-agent count of 3 and a neighbor count of 4 should not be reachable at
all: something outside the fixture (a late startup-loader or fleet-refresh apply landing
after the capture) is repopulating the local agent list under load. That leak, not the
pixels, is the thing to fix. Do not accept the drifting capture as a new golden.

Related unmitigated instance of the same class recorded by sase-12z.5.2: the footer
`#keybinding-status` region keeps a stale auto-width cache after the startup stopwatch
ends, because Textual caches Widget content width by container width and `Static.update`
does not clear it. That was mitigated for toast goldens with `stabilize_toast_frame`;
`KeybindingStatusMixin._update_status` may need `clear_cached_dimensions()`.

payload.description: Same class: an ACE visual PNG golden that fails intermittently and order/load dependently rather than from a real rendering change.

Same fleet-refresh subsystem, different node: sase-12a is test_fleet_refresh_apply_defers_behind_active_navigation; a late fleet-refresh apply is the leading hypothesis for this golden's contamination too.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 on host apollo, workspace sase_17, master 624a29ea72: agents_fleet_remote_tribe_families_120x40 drifts deterministically outside a saturated lane. It showed updated=1 in a full Agents-corpus 'just fix-tui-screenshots --check' (127 tests, 4 workers) and again in a targeted 2-file run on a CLEAN tree (local changes stashed), i.e. 2 of 2 runs, so it is not only a live-neighbor/host-load flake on this host. The contact-sheet diff sits in the remote tribe-families panel rows.

Independent repro 2026-09-20 under host load1 23-32: agents_fleet_remote_tribe_families drifted in 2 of 3 runs on ec7dbbfdf+sase-11y.10.1.2 (a full 710-golden --check and one targeted run drifted; one targeted run passed) and did not drift in one targeted run on a pristine export of ec7dbbfdf, with identical code in every run, so the drift is non-deterministic.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 on a host at load 28-40: agents_fleet_remote_tribe_families_120x40 failed fix-tui-screenshots verification (capture vs verify body diff, 'here: athena 1 active' vs '3 active', neighbors row appearing). Also test_agents_fleet_followed_partial_offline failed verify with '2 machines' missing. HEAD golden also drifts vs a fresh capture in this workspace.
